caption: The drawing features a single object resembling a bird decoy, oriented to the right. The bird’s form has a long, straight beak and a gently sloping head leading into a smooth, rounded body. The coloring consists mainly of muted browns and dark grays, with the upper section of the bird’s body shaded in dark gray and the lower section in a lighter brown hue. There are small, dark spots distributed around the body, particularly along the gray area, and a soft gradient transition between the brown and gray sections. The background is a plain, light beige color without any additional objects or textures. The artist's signature, "CHRIST MAKRENOS," appears in cursive at the lower left of the image.
title: Wooden Decoy
